notes: Standard clause library. Boilerplate stays boilerplate - these are stitched in verbatim. Project-specific prose is written separately and never replaces a clause here.

clauses.title: Provisional scope - no site walk performed
clauses.text: This scope of work has been prepared WITHOUT a site walk. No site conditions described in this document have been physically verified by {company}. Quantities, cable lengths, pathways, mounting surfaces and existing infrastructure are stated on the basis set out in Section 6 (Assumptions) and are subject to change once the site is surveyed. Pricing derived from this scope is provisional and will be revised where actual conditions differ from the assumptions stated.

clauses.title: Scope based on site walk
clauses.text: This scope of work is based on a site walk performed on {site_walk_date}, attended by {site_walk_attendees}. Conditions described in Section 5 were observed during that walk. Items not observed are identified as assumptions in Section 6 and remain subject to verification.

clauses.title: Partial site walk
clauses.text: The site walk did not cover the entire premises. Areas not accessed are listed in Section 6 and are scoped on an assumed basis with the same status as an unwalked project.

clauses.title: Draft for review
clauses.text: This document is a draft prepared for internal review. It must be reviewed and approved by the responsible account executive and operations lead before it is issued to the customer.

clauses.title: Installation standards
clauses.text: All cabling shall be installed in accordance with applicable national and local codes, manufacturer specifications and industry standard practice. Cable shall be supported independently of ceiling grid and other trades' systems, labelled at both ends, and tested prior to handover. Plenum-rated cable shall be used in all plenum spaces.

clauses.title: Testing and commissioning
clauses.text: All installed devices will be tested for correct operation, connectivity and recording or reporting to the designated head-end system. A point-to-point verification will be completed prior to handover, and a device schedule will be provided listing each device, its location and its designation in the head-end system.

clauses.title: Site cleanup
clauses.text: Work areas will be left clean at the end of each working day. Packaging, cable offcuts and debris generated by our work will be removed from site.

clauses.title: Training
clauses.text: End-user training is included as described above. Training covers day-to-day operation of the installed systems and is delivered in a single session unless stated otherwise.

clauses.title: Subcontractor scope boundary
clauses.text: Work identified as subcontracted is performed by {subcontractor_name} under our direction. The boundary of their work is as stated in this section. Any work not expressly listed as theirs remains ours, and any work not listed in this document at all is excluded from both parties' scope until scoped and priced separately.

clauses.title: Subcontractor pricing - quote received
clauses.text: Subcontractor pricing reflected in this scope is based on a written quote received from {subcontractor_name}. That quote is held subject to its own stated validity period and to the conditions on which it was prepared. Where the subcontractor's quote was prepared without their own site visit, their pricing carries the same verification risk as the rest of this provisional scope.

clauses.title: Subcontractor pricing - quote outstanding
clauses.text: No subcontractor quote has been received at the time of writing. The subcontracted portion of this scope is UNPRICED. Any figure carried against it is a placeholder and is not a commitment. This scope must not be issued as a firm price until the subcontractor's quote is received and reconciled against the boundary described in this section.

clauses.title: Self-performed
clauses.text: All work described in this scope is self-performed. No subcontracted labour is carried.

clauses.title: Subcontractor not yet identified
clauses.text: Portions of this work are expected to be subcontracted, but no subcontractor has been identified at the time of writing. Subcontracted labour is therefore unpriced and unbounded in this document. This is an open item and must be resolved before the scope is issued as a firm price.

clauses.title: Standing assumptions
clauses.text: Unless stated otherwise in this section: the customer provides safe, clear and timely access to all work areas during the agreed working hours; existing electrical, network and pathway infrastructure is serviceable and has adequate capacity; ceilings and walls are of standard construction and free of undisclosed obstruction; and no hazardous material abatement is required to complete the work.

clauses.title: Device counts
clauses.text: Device quantities in this scope are based on the information stated in Section 6 and have not been verified on site. Quantities are subject to revision following a site survey.

clauses.title: Standard exclusions
clauses.text: The following are excluded from this scope unless expressly stated as included: line voltage electrical work and any work requiring a licensed electrician; fire alarm system modification, programming or tie-in; patching, painting, finishing or restoration of any surface; core drilling of structural elements; asbestos or hazardous material survey, handling or abatement; permits, engineered drawings and stamped submittals; network infrastructure, switching, licensing and IP address provisioning; customer-side firewall, VPN and remote access configuration; door hardware, door and frame modification, and locksmith work; trenching, boring, concrete cutting and landscape restoration; and any work not expressly described in this document.

clauses.title: Permits and inspections
clauses.text: Permit fees, permit application, engineered drawings and any inspection required by the authority having jurisdiction are excluded. Where a permit is required, the schedule is contingent on it being issued and any resulting delay is not our responsibility.

clauses.title: Working hours
clauses.text: Pricing is based on work performed during normal business hours. Work required outside those hours, or rescheduled at the customer's request, is subject to additional cost.

clauses.title: Changes to scope
clauses.text: Any change to the work described in this document, including changes arising from conditions found to differ from those stated, will be documented and priced as a change order and requires written approval before the work is performed.

clauses.title: Differing site conditions
clauses.text: Where conditions encountered on site differ materially from those described in this document, work affected by the difference will stop and the customer will be notified before additional cost is incurred.

clauses.title: Customer responsibilities
clauses.text: The customer is responsible for providing site access and any required badging or escort; a secure area for material storage; network connectivity, IP addressing and switch capacity where the head-end is customer-provided; and timely decisions on any open item identified in this document. Delay arising from these items is not our responsibility.

clauses.title: Validity
clauses.text: This scope and any associated pricing are valid for thirty (30) days from the date of issue and are subject to material availability and manufacturer lead times at the time of order.

clauses.title: Site access requirements
clauses.text: The site access requirements stated in this document have been accounted for in the schedule. Requirements identified after issue - including background checks, union labour, escorted access or insurance certificates beyond our standard coverage - may affect cost and schedule.
